summary:
[  edit  ]
The Polypatch  SOP  creates a smooth polygonal patch from a mesh primitive or a set of faces (polygons, NURBS or Bezier curves).

parameters.label: Group
parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Subset of input to use. Accepts patterns, as described in  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: Basis
parameters.name: basis
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select spline type:  Cardinal  or  BSpline .

parameters.label: Connectivity
parameters.name: connecttype
parameters.description: ⊞  - This option is used to select how the points of the created surface are connected.

parameters.label: Rows
parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Creates horizontal lines, which are open polygons.

parameters.label: Columns
parameters.name: cols
parameters.description: Creates vertical lines, which are open polygons.

parameters.label: Rows and Columns
parameters.name: rowcol
parameters.description: Both rows and columns, all open polygons.

parameters.label: Triangles
parameters.name: triangles
parameters.description: Build the grid with triangles.

parameters.label: Quadrilaterals
parameters.name: quads
parameters.description: Default grid connection - four-sided quadrilaterals.

parameters.label: Alternating Triangles
parameters.name: alttriangles
parameters.description: Generates triangles that are opposed; similar to the Triangles option.

parameters.label: Inherit from Source
parameters.name: inheritconnect
parameters.description: When this connectivity option is selected, the output mesh will have the same connectivity as the input hull mesh.

parameters.label: U Wrap
parameters.name: closeu
parameters.description: ⊞  - Settings for wrapping in U direction.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: nonewu
parameters.description: Do not wrap in U/V.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: wu
parameters.description: Wrap in U/V.

parameters.label: If  Primitive  does
parameters.name: ifprimwu
parameters.description: Wrap in U/V if the input primitive does.

parameters.label: V Wrap
parameters.name: closev
parameters.description: ⊞  - Settings for wrapping in V direction.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: nonewv
parameters.description: Do not wrap in U/V.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: wv
parameters.description: Wrap in U/V.

parameters.label: If  Primitive  does
parameters.name: ifprimwv
parameters.description: Wrap in U/V if the input primitive does.

parameters.label: U Clamp (First)
parameters.name: firstuclamp
parameters.description: ⊞  - Settings for clamping first end in U.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: firstuclampoff
parameters.description: Do not clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: firstuclampon
parameters.description: Clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction.

parameters.label: If primitive does
parameters.name: firstuclampifprim
parameters.description: Clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction if the input primitive does.

parameters.label: U Clamp (Last)
parameters.name: lastuclamp
parameters.description: ⊞  - Settings for clamping last end in U.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: lastuclampoff
parameters.description: Do not clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: lastuclampon
parameters.description: Clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction.

parameters.label: If primitive does
parameters.name: lastuclampifprim
parameters.description: Clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction if the input primitive does.

parameters.label: V Clamp (First)
parameters.name: firstvclamp
parameters.description: ⊞  - Settings for clamping first end in V.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: firstvclampoff
parameters.description: Do not clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: firstvclampon
parameters.description: Clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction.

parameters.label: If primitive does
parameters.name: firstvclampifprim
parameters.description: Clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction if the input primitive does.

parameters.label: V Clamp (Last)
parameters.name: lastvclamp
parameters.description: ⊞  - Settings for clamping last end in V.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: lastvclampoff
parameters.description: Do not clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: lastvclampon
parameters.description: Clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction.

parameters.label: If primitive does
parameters.name: lastvclampifprim
parameters.description: Clamp the first/last end in the U/V direction if the input primitive does.

parameters.label: Output Divisions
parameters.name: divisions
parameters.description: ⊞  - The number of divisions in the output surface. Use more divisions for a smoother surface.

parameters.label: Output Polygons
parameters.name: polys
parameters.description: Force polygonal rather than mesh output.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: The Graphics Processing Unit. This is the high
parameters.description: speed, many-core processor of the graphics card/chip that takes geometry, images and data from the CPU and creates images and processed data.
